com.datastax.oss.driver.api.querybuilder.update

Interface UpdateWithAssignments

  • All Superinterfaces:
    OngoingAssignment, OngoingWhereClause<Update>

    public interface UpdateWithAssignments
extends OngoingAssignment, OngoingWhereClause<Update>
    An UPDATE statement that has at least one assignment. You can keep adding assignments, or add WHERE clauses to get a buildable statement.
